summary: Discover how to design impactful pension plans for your small business. Join our training course and empower your team with essential retirement strategies.
lede: Pension plan design helps small businesses shape retirement benefits around workforce needs and available budgets. For owners, HR and finance professionals involved in employee benefits, this course covers comparing plan structures, setting contribution and eligibility rules, assessing costs and providers, and explaining the plan clearly to staff, with attention to governance and regular reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is crafted for professionals in small and medium-sized businesses who are involved in making or influencing decisions about employee benefits and long-term incentives.
audience: Directors and partners in professional firms
modules: Pension Fundamentals for Small Business Leaders
Understanding Pension Plan Types and Structures
Cost, Funding, and Affordability for SMEs
Designing Contribution Rules and Eligibility Criteria
Investment Choices and Risk for Non-Specialists
Pension Plans, Talent Retention, and Employer Brand
Reviewing, Adjusting, and Future-Proofing Your Plan
prerequisites: No prior pension design experience is required, but familiarity with HR or financial concepts is beneficial.
